headline: Lehigh wins at Boston University and Bucknell in November
dek: Lehigh, level with Bucknell on points, took both four days apart, then lost its latest match away to a non-conference side. Boston University, top of the table, scored more than any other programme and conceded 15 in its seventeen matches.
